summary: Road flooding after heavy rain. Photographs in a JICA survey show flooded road near Henveiru Ground and on the central part of Majeedhee Magu.
Non-stop afternoon rain, water in homes. Rain from Sunday afternoon flooded streets and seeped into some homes. Firefighters pumped out roads near the Ekuveni running track and the IGMH area.
locations: Ekuveni running track; IGMH area (Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital)

summary: Late-night storm, Maafannu worst hit. A storm late on 1 April left roads hard to walk the next day, with Maafannu worst affected and households flooded.
Torrential morning rain across all four wards. The Met Office reported severe flooding on many roads in all four districts of Malé. No streets were named.
reported_rainfall: Heaviest at Hulhulé, 08:00 to 11:00 (no figure published)

summary: Record rain at Hulhulé, more than 140 homes flooded. Ameenee Magu, Boduthakurufaanu Magu and Majeedhee Magu were heavily flooded. Hulhumalé roads and the highway also flooded, as did Hulhulé. Pumps ran at two sites near IGMH, West Park and near the Polytechnic; four houses flooded in Henveiru.
reported_rainfall: Hulhulé 179.9 mm in 24 h (record), Malé 118.2 mm

summary: Evening downpour, four pumping sites. MNDF drained water on Boduthakurufaanu Magu, at Kudakudhinge Bageecha, the former West Park area and the STO flour warehouse area.

summary: Torrential rain, soldiers drain streets. Pumps ran at the flour warehouse, IGMH, West Park and Boduthakurufaanu Magu. Ameenee Magu was photographed under water.
locations: STO flour warehouse area; IGMH area (Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital); West Park area; Boduthakurufaanu Magu; Ameenee Magu

summary: Nearly every street flooded, public holiday declared. Rain from about 11:00 flooded nearly all streets; police asked four-wheeled vehicles to stay off the roads. Worst areas named were IGMH, West Park, Pizza Buona, Dhiraagu and Dharubaaruge; Rasfannu was closed. Ameenee Magu was photographed flooded. Villimalé also flooded and was pumped out. 256 households in Malé reported flooding.
locations: IGMH area (Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital); West Park area; Pizza Buona area; Dhiraagu head office area; Dharubaaruge area; Rasfannu; Ameenee Magu; Villimalé (streets not named)

summary: 136.5 mm in 24 hours. Flooding centred on the West Park and IGMH area, the STO flour warehouse, the Villimalé ferry terminal and Dhiraagu head office. The council then repaired Majeedhee Magu, Chaandhanee Magu and Rahdhebai Magu and closed Majeedhee Magu between Dhanburuh Magu and Nikagas Magu for drainage work.
reported_rainfall: Malé 136.5 mm, Hulhumalé 117 mm (8am Fri to 8am Sat)
locations: West Park area; IGMH area (Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital); STO flour warehouse area; Maafannu (Villimalé) Ferry Terminal; Dhiraagu head office area; Majeedhee Magu, Dhanburuh Magu to Nikagas Magu; Majeedhee Magu; Chaandhanee Magu

summary: Largest event in the record: 30,569 tonnes pumped out. Rain from Thursday evening flooded most of the city until Saturday morning. Majeedhee Magu and Ameenee Magu became impassable; water passed two feet on Kan'baa Aisa Rani Hingun and Izzuddeen Magu. Pumps ran at West Park, IGMH, Salman Mosque, Maafannu Ferry Terminal, Kudakudhinge Bageecha and Voice of Maldives. Pavement at Rasfannu was dug up to drain water. Burials at Hulhumalé cemetery were suspended days later.
reported_rainfall: Malé 142.2 mm (162 mm by 11pm in another count), Hulhulé 144 mm, Hulhumalé 122 to 164 mm
locations: Majeedhee Magu; Ameenee Magu; Kan'baa Aisa Rani Hingun; Izzuddeen Magu; West Park area; IGMH area (Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital); King Salman Mosque area; Maafannu (Villimalé) Ferry Terminal; Kudakudhinge Bageecha (children's park, Ameenee Magu); Voice of Maldives area; Rasfannu; Hulhumalé Cemetery

summary: Early-morning torrential rain, 58 households assisted. MNDF drained streets and helped 58 households. No streets were named.

Two-hour evening cloudburst. About two hours of rain after sunset flooded several areas under an orange warning. Pumps went to ten locations, including the IGMH area, West Park and the Maafannu ferry terminal.

locations: IGMH area (Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital); West Park area; Maafannu (Villimalé) Ferry Terminal

summary: Early-morning rain floods Maafannu. Parts of Maafannu flooded; floodwater was photographed near IGMH.
locations: Maafannu ward (streets not named); IGMH area (Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital)

summary: Downpours, pumps in Maafannu. MNDF deployed pumps at two locations in Maafannu.
Thunderstorms, IGMH area among worst hit. Dewatering took place around IGMH, the Maafannu Ferry Terminal, the Salman Mosque area and the Swimming Track area.
locations: IGMH area (Indira Gandhi Memorial Hospital); Maafannu (Villimalé) Ferry Terminal; King Salman Mosque area; Swimming Track area

locations: Boduthakurufaanu Magu, Henveiru Ferry Terminal to Izzuddin Jetty

summary: Non-stop evening rain, 89 buildings flooded. Rain from around sundown flooded the whole city. 89 buildings reported flooding, including 35 shops, 33 houses and 4 schools. No streets were named. Burials at Hulhumalé cemetery were suspended on 24 October after graves filled with water.
locations: Malé city-wide (streets not named); Hulhumalé Cemetery
